about: Who the people in a pursuit are, as DATA for src/space-membership-kinds.mjs: each kind says what someone must hold from this service to join a pursuit of that kind. `plan_feature` names a feature row of src/plan-comparison.json the joiner's own plan must include (judged allowance-aware, the same rule its plan card shows), or is null when joining never needs anything from this service; then only the pursuit owner's own join rules and what the owner sold decide (src/community.mjs mayJoin). A joiner whose plan lacks the feature is covered by a free seat of the pursuit owner's team purchase when one is open (src/seats.mjs), taken as they join; otherwise they are refused with `words.needs_plan`. A label's default kind is its `members_are` in src/network-settings.json membership_labels; a pursuit names its own in its configuration (`members_are`), set by whoever its rules let change it (change_community). A label with no `members_are` and a pursuit that names none have no kind: anyone the pursuit lets in joins. Members already in a pursuit are never put out when its kind or their plan changes; a kind is judged as someone joins. Words fill {space} and {owner}.

team.label: Your team
team.about: People who work in this pursuit with you on Trillion. Each one has a paid plan, or a seat you pay for.

customers.label: Your members or customers
customers.about: People who join what you run. You decide whether joining is free or paid; they never need a Trillion plan.

words.needs_plan: {space} is a team space: joining it comes with a paid Trillion plan, or a seat {owner} pays for.
words.needs_plan_unnamed: {space} is a team space: joining it comes with a paid Trillion plan, or a seat the person who runs it pays for.
